race.description: Ascension Finance - Home Loan Specialist Mdn Plate
race.comment: MAREMOTO (7) ran on stoutly to get up for third two back over 1400m at this track. Went forward last time and wasn't as strong at the end of 1500m at Muswellbrook. The mile shouldn't be a problem if ridden colder - can win if things go right. ROBBED BY ROB (3) stoked up before the corner then really found the line with gusto but missed in a photo over this course and distance last time. Great chance to go one better with a little added fitness this afternoon. NAMBI GHIMA (8) made significant progress last start at the second run of the prep, closing strongly to just miss the placings over 1400m at Kembla. Ran third at her only try at the mile. Should be peaking now at the third run back. SHARE OUR SECRET (4) has had plenty of chances. Good effort eight days ago over this distance at Gunnedah. Each-way hope in this better maiden. PRESUMPTUOUS GAL (9) is yet to place in four first-up runs so her failure when resuming over 1400m at Kembla last time is forgivable. Can improve sharply.
